description: Two-stage hierarchical k-NN over a pre-built FAISS IVF+PQ index of IBM Granite multilingual embeddings: domain-level search scoped to loaded skills, then intent-level scoring with Wu-Lin pairwise probability estimation.
model: IBM Granite Embedding 97M Multilingual R2 (quint8 ONNX) + FAISS index
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate; per-plugin config keeps the shipped defaults. Published predictions are migrated from the legacy ovos-intent-benchmark, where this engine was trained on the benchmark's own corpora; the pinned pretrained model targets real OVOS skill intents and cannot emit this benchmark's label space, so native re-sweeps require a dataset-trained variant.
